options.name: Ties with ex-colonies cut
options.desc: The country has cut ties with its ex-colonies. They are not expected to receive special treatment from us and vice versa.

options.name: Lingering influence in ex-colonies
options.desc: The country still has strong economic and political ties with its ex-colonies, including Erdia, Passala and Elenia

options.name: Ex-colony partnership
options.desc: The country has increased cooperation with its former colonies, creating a defensive alliance and a customs union.
